CustomField.description: Admin hard-delete window for WorkItem__c. While this is in the future, the before-delete guard in DeliveryWorkItemTriggerHandler lets WorkItems be hard-deleted (for example clearing a sandbox board). Blank or past = deletes refused (default; zero behavior change). The window closes by itself when the time passes. Hierarchy setting: stamp it on one admin user to open it for that user only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set to a time in the near future to allow WorkItems to be hard-deleted until then. Leave blank to keep deletes blocked; use Deactivate instead.
CustomField.label: Allow Work Item Hard Delete Until
